description: The sea ice component in NESM is based on the CICE Consortium sea-ice model version 6.0 (CICE v6.0 with Icepack v1.1 column physics; Craig et al., 2018; Hunke et al., 2018), discretised on a 320 x 384 displaced-pole Arakawa-B horizontal grid (gx1v6). It is configured with elastic-viscous-plastic (EVP) rheology for ice dynamics, incremental remapping horizontal advection, mechanical redistribution via ridging, and multilayer snow and ice thermodynamics. Surface albedo and shortwave radiative transfer through snow and sea ice are represented using the Delta-Eddington multiple-scattering parameterization accounting for melt ponds and snow metamorphosis.
